accepts.description: Marine forecast bundle, Gulf region, 5 days

evidence_transcript.detail: The agent signed an EIP-3009 transfer authorization for exactly 100000 atomic USDC to the payTo named in the challenge, valid for 300 seconds, and resubmitted the request with the payment payload. Authorization nonce: 0xDLXNONCE0001 (synthetic placeholder).

evidence_transcript.note: Verification confirms the authorization is well formed and acceptable. Verification alone does not move funds.

evidence_transcript.detail: A read-only chain lookup by the operator finds a USDC Transfer log matching the settlement: token contract 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913, from the buyer wallet, to the challenge payTo, value 100000.

evidence_transcript.note: The second 402 carries a fresh authorization nonce window and makes no reference to the settled payment or to orderRef MWG-2026-8841 being fulfilled.
evidence_transcript.request: GET /v1/marine/forecast-bundle?region=gulf&days=5 with the settled payment reference and orderRef MWG-2026-8841

evidence_transcript.detail: The agent framework logged an intent to restart the payment flow from step 1 (a second full payment). The operator halted the agent before any second authorization was signed. No second payment exists.

mystery: Payload Dead Letter Exchange, Mystery 001: The Forecast That Never Arrived

the_situation: An autonomous research agent paid 0.10 USDC through x402 for a marine weather data bundle. The payment verified. The settlement landed on chain. The data never arrived, and asking again produced a fresh demand to pay. The operator of the agent halted its automatic retry before it could pay a second time, and kept the full transcript. That transcript is this case.
